This certifies that portable electrical equipment in healthcare settings at Westside Community Hospital 
has been tested to the highest safety standards, ensuring patient in accordance with healthcare-specific 
electrical safety protocols, HTM 06-01 guidance, and the Electricity at Work Regulations 1989.
Tester Name: Alan Hughes (Medical PAT Qualified)
All life-support and critical care equipment subject to enhanced testing protocols. Test records available for CQC inspection.
